http://rune.ai
Talk & play multiplayer games with your friends!
Rune is the best place to talk and play multiplayer games with your friends. Users hang out on Rune’s mobile app, sharing laughs on our voice chat as they play amazing indie multiplayer games together! And developers build these games right on the Rune platform.
Developers leverage the Rune SDK to build multiplayer games without needing a single line of backend code. They launch their game on Rune and instantly, thousands of passionate friend groups play it together on voice chat right inside the Rune app!
And these games are played like crazy too — friends have spent over 50 million minutes hanging out and playing our new games together already.
Active Founders
Sanjay Guruprasad
Sanjay Guruprasad
Twitter account
Founder
Sanjay's been hacking away on a computer as far back as he can remember (perks of his mom and dad both being programmers).
He studied Physics at IIT Madras and was working towards a PhD on Network Effects at MIT before dropping out to start Rune. Rune combines all his passions -- gaming, social networks and some hardcore Software engineering. Outside of work, Sanjay loves to run, bike, play the guitar and of course code some more / blog about coding :)

Rune v1.3 is released Now open source!
The development environment for pros
A terminal multiplexer
is simply not enough.
Rune is where codebase intelligence meets a state-of-the-art terminal experience, for manual or automatic programming. Write code fast. Review even faster.
Download for Mac ▾
$ curl -fsSL https://rune.build/install.sh | sh Copy
Rune in Action
macOS · Linux · Windows coming soon · homebrew, nix and manual install →
UNIX and the command line solved tool integration fifty years ago. Rune brings it back to the IDE, built around a command prompt for driving actions, a console for managing the IDE, infinitely splittable terminal tiles, all under one set of key bindings. What else do you need?
